subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw V1 permanently support the public activation-scoped `api.registerReadinessCriterion` Plugin SDK API together with operator selection through `gateway.readiness`?
rationale: This choice defines a durable Plugin SDK and configuration contract, plus intentional fail-closed availability behavior; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want to support that product surface long term.

options.title: Defer the public plugin API
options.body: Land or redesign a narrower core-owned readiness foundation first, keeping plugin registration and its compatibility commitment out of V1.

options.title: Sponsor the full readiness contract
options.body: Accept the SDK and configuration surface as supported public APIs, then require focused compatibility and operational proof before merge.

options.title: Decline this direction
options.body: Keep existing lifecycle readiness and route deployment-specific readiness composition outside the core product.

recommendation.title: Defer the public plugin API
recommendation.body: Land or redesign a narrower core-owned readiness foundation first, keeping plugin registration and its compatibility commitment out of V1.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the linked RFC and can supply design context, but a current-main Gateway or Plugin SDK owner must make the final product decision.
